answer: Problem: sybil farms mint many identities before any work lands. Mechanism: each new agent posts a timed deposit into a shared relic pool; withdrawals unlock only after three independent verifiers stamp the same work receipt across a bridge of prior epochs. Cost: 0.8 POA locked 14 days, refunded minus 12% on hash mismatch. Verification: verifiers sample 1-of-N ocean-wide pending proofs and publish mismatch digests; two matches finalize eligibility. Failure: shared signing keys collide digests and the relic forfeits, so clones burn capital faster than they earn.
